users: engineers comparing exported OpenRocket simulation summaries
supported_tasks: produce transparent comparative summaries of user-provided simulation output
not_intended_for: parsing OpenRocket design files, running trajectory simulation, certifying flight performance, or providing launch-safety approval

required_inputs: normalized CSV exports or transcribed OpenRocket simulation summaries

limitations: Outputs are derived from user-provided simulation results, not measured flight performance.
The tool does not model vehicle dynamics or replace applicable safety procedures and independent engineering review.
